additional_manifestations.title: A strengthening of the Nyman–Beurling criterion for the Riemann hypothesis
additional_manifestations.doi_scope: DataCite identifier for the arXiv preprint
additional_manifestations.publication_status: Original arXiv preprint inspected. Relation to the published journal article verified by title, author, main theorem and the precise Balazard–Saias estimate in the indexed journal scan.
additional_manifestations.journal_relation_scope: Journal form adds a section on a constructive approximating sequence, with distinct numbering and pagination. Direct bdim PDF download returned HTTP 503. The indexed journal scan displayed Lemma 1 and equation (2.1) on p. 6.
additional_manifestations.version_history: The v2 arXiv comment reports three typographical corrections and one added reference.
additional_manifestations.read_scope: Partial close reading of §§1–3 of arXiv v2, covering the main criterion, the quoted Möbius estimate, the quotient estimate and the ordered norm limits. Journal Lemma 1 was located independently in the indexed scan.
additional_manifestations.main_result: Theorem 1.1 in arXiv v2, and Theorem 1 on journal p. 5. RH is equivalent to the indicator of (0,1] lying in the closed L²(0,∞) span of the fractional parts {1/(nx)} for positive integers n.
additional_manifestations.reusable_lemma: ArXiv v2 Lemma 2.1, p. 3, equation (2.1), and journal Lemma 1, p. 6, equation (2.1), reproduce the fixed-gap Möbius approximation of PAPER-E007, Lemme 2, for any zero-free half-plane Re(s)>b, 1/2≤b<1.
additional_manifestations.selection_reason: Original source for the discrete Báez-Duarte criterion and a verified formula-complete quotation of the Balazard–Saias lemma used in the corrected weighted criterion.
additional_manifestations.manifestation_role: February revision, with original record preserved

additional_manifestations.title: A strengthening of the Nyman-Beurling criterion for the Riemann hypothesis, 2
additional_manifestations.read_scope: Complete nine-page preprint text read; ordered-limit argument reconstructed; external dependencies not fully independently checked.
additional_manifestations.venue: arXiv preprint; distinct from original math/0202141 and subsequent published text
additional_manifestations.main_result: In H=L²((0,infinity),dx), let rho_a(x)={1/(a x)}, chi=1_(0,1], and B_nat=span{rho_a:a in positive integers}. RH iff chi belongs to the H closure of B_nat (Theorem1.1, pp.1–2). Under RH, for some c>0, ||chi+sum_{a<=n}mu(a)exp(-c log(a)/loglog(n))rho_a||_H << (loglog(n))^(-1/3) (Proposition3.1, pp.6–8).
proof_architecture: RH plus Balazard–Saias truncated Möbius estimate
Mellin transform of fractional part is -zeta(s)/s in 0<Re(s)<1
H convergence n→infinity for fixed sufficiently small epsilon
H convergence epsilon↓0 to -chi, then closure
limitations: No RH-independent construction attaining convergence is supplied.
The two limits are ordered; pointwise convergence of raw Möbius truncations does not imply H convergence.
Proposition3.1 is a sketch with external input.
Displayed integrability range in p.5 needs epsilon<1/4 for the particular majorant; sufficiently small epsilon suffices.
additional_manifestations.historical_importance: Reduces continuous dilation parameters to integer dilations; turns an abstract closure criterion into arithmetic approximation.
additional_manifestations.reusable_lemma: Lemma2.2 bounds |zeta(1/2-epsilon+it)/zeta(1/2+epsilon+it)| by C(1+|t|)^epsilon, for 0<=epsilon<=epsilon0<1/2, interpreted at removable common zeros; the functional equation supplies the modulus bound.
research_questions: Can a quantitative uniform error bound replace the sequential limiting argument?
Which smoothing schemes preserve norm convergence with a useful explicit rate?
additional_manifestations.original_notation: See downloaded source; normalized notation in this record uses rho for a zero except rho_a in E001.
additional_manifestations.correction_search_status: arXiv history inspected; exhaustive later-correction search incomplete
additional_manifestations.manifestation_role: Expanded May deposit; original Level 1 source record preserved

fields.related_deposit: PAPER-E001 is a stable work alias for the expanded May preprint, not a separate selected work.
fields.main_result: Journal Theorem 1 (p5, proof pp6–9): in H=L²(0,infinity), RH iff chi=1_(0,1] belongs to the closure of the span of rho_n(x)={1/(nx)} for every integer n≥1. Journal Theorem 2 (pp9–10), the same result as expanded May Proposition3.1: under RH, for some fixed c>0 the damped Möbius approximants with exponent c/loglog n have norm error O((loglog n)^(−1/3)).
fields.reusable_lemma: Journal Lemma 2 (pp6–7), expanded May Lemma2.2 and February Lemma2.2 with a version-specific gamma typo: the symmetric zeta quotient has modulus at most C_(epsilon0)(1+|t|)^epsilon for 0≤epsilon≤epsilon0<1/2, by the functional equation and uniform Stirling, with removable common zero values.
fields.original_notation: rho_a denotes fractional-part dilations, chi the target indicator, H the full-half-axis L2 space. Historical E001 identifies the expanded May deposit; theorem numbering remains manifestation-specific.
fields.read_scope: Complete pinned journal, seven article pages, independently reconstructed by two agents and director. The integer criterion, corollary and RH-conditional rate survive local normalization/range/tail repairs and the separately established shrinking-gap supplement. The May and February deposits retain distinct manifestations and original reading scopes.
fields.claim_verification_status: Whole-work Level 3 for the exact journal manifestation; original printed hypotheses and repaired deductions are distinguished. No RH proof or new rate claimed.
limitations: All positive integer dilations including 1 are required.
Norm limits are ordered; unconditional analytic-kernel convergence does not identify the actual damped functions off RH.
The particular printed majorant needs epsilon<1/4; a free subpower exponent proves the fixed weighted range epsilon<1/2.
Uniform shrinking-gap constants require the reconstructed supplement; no practical onset or optimality claimed.
fields.journal_relation_scope: The original 2003 journal incorporates the quantitative theorem of the expanded May deposit; the author confirms this preprint relation in a contemporary self-citation.
fields.version_history: February v1/v2, expanded May deposit under a second arXiv ID, then 2003 journal. Exact hashes, dates and equation numbering preserved in quality/baez_manifestation_identity_round13.json.
fields.correction_history: Journal fixes February gamma denominator and transform interval. Local Mellin normalization, particular majorant range, tail exponent and conditional-identification qualifications have existing finding handles. Bounded search found no separately verified corrigendum.

fields.claim_verification_status: Complete Level 1 reading. The published O(log T) count and the scoped kernel comparisons retain separate evidence. The improved historical coefficient is not a modern best bound or weighted-tail advance.
